final: WITH groups AS (SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM groups) SELECT groups.ordervault, groups.group_count, 1.0 * groups.group_count / totals.total_count AS quotient FROM groups CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY quotient DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
